COMMITTING: git push is 403 'denied to Onyx-Node' for the fixer too, not only for subagents - the App has no write access to kavopdf/app over HTTPS git. It is not a dead end: the GitHub MCP tool GITHUB_COMMIT_MULTIPLE_FILES (owner kavopdf, repo app, branch main, upserts=[{path,content,encoding:utf-8}]) commits several files atomically and worked for all four commits of this run. The next run should commit that way, then 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' so HEAD matches origin, then chain.py. chain.py's sync check is strict SHA equality and also refuses a dirty tree, and it rewrites CHAIN.json - so commit CHAIN.json again after each chain.py run.

context: STEP 3/3 fixer, class single-element-far-out (1 doc: newsletter-3col-header-footer). FOUND AND FIXED A STATE BUG IN columnPage: after writing the newspaper-column layout table it set ctx.afterTablePt = rowEndPt but never advanced ctx.flowY, so the flow stayed 70.2 pt above the table's real bottom edge. A TABLE placed after the columns reads flowTopPt(), not afterTablePt, so the stats band under the columns got a spacer equal to that whole stale gap and landed on the running footer (labels at 764.3 where the page drew 688.6; band bottom 797.7 against a footer at 802.3). Fix: ctx.flowY = rowEndPt; ctx.flowBoxPt = 0f (DocxWriter.java, end of columnPage). Measured: share5 3.45->3.13, max_pt 77.28->22.08, p90 9.6->6.24, median 2.4->1.92. FULL CORPUS 213 of 213: exactly ONE document moved, none worse, none better by the 0.5 bar. classrow refuses FIXED because baseline share5 was already 3.45 (<5.0), so the row is OPEN with the new numbers and the class is closed by reclassification instead (max_pt 22.08 no longer meets the class rule max_pt>30).
